北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京有霾，出门记得戴口罩，保护好呼吸道哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing has haze. Remember to wear a mask outdoors to protect your respiratory health!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪雾气浓，体感偏凉。出行注意安全，记得添衣保暖哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is foggy and feels cool. Be careful when traveling, and dress warmly!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海雾蒙蒙，体感微凉。出行慢点，别忘了加件衣服哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is foggy and a bit cool. Travel safely, and don't forget an extra layer!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州雾气重，湿度大。出行小心，注意除湿，保持好心情！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is very humid and foggy. Be careful when traveling, dehumidify, and stay cheerful!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳雾气弥漫，湿度高。开车慢行，注意防潮，保持舒适！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is foggy and humid. Drive slowly, watch out for dampness, and stay comfortable!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州雾大潮湿，体感微凉。出行放慢，注意防滑，照顾好自己！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is foggy, damp, and cool. Travel slowly, watch out for slippery surfaces, and take care!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京雾锁城，湿度 100%。路面湿滑，请慢行，注意保暖防潮！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is enveloped in fog, 100% humid. Roads are slippery, drive slowly, and stay warm and dry!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，湿度高。记得防潮，保持室内通风，心情也保持晴朗哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast and humid. Remember to dehumidify, ventilate your home, and keep your spirits bright!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉雾气弥漫，湿度 100%。路面湿滑，注意慢行，别着凉了！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy and 100% humid. Roads are slippery, drive slowly, and don't catch a cold!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云但湿度 100%。注意防潮保暖，小心路滑，别感冒哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy but 100% humid. Stay warm and dry, watch out for slippery roads, and don't catch a cold!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天潮湿，气温适中。记得防潮通风，让心情也“转晴”！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast and humid, with mild temperatures. Remember to dehumidify and ventilate, and brighten your mood!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨阴天伴强风，体感 0℃。风大体寒，务必多穿，小心着凉！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is overcast with strong winds, feeling like 0℃. It's cold and windy, so layer up and stay warm!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阳光好，但体感稍凉。外出注意保暖，别忘了多喝水哦！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny but feels a bit cool. Dress warmly when going out, and remember to drink more water!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云潮湿，体感微凉。记得带伞，注意防潮，照顾好自己！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy, humid, and a bit cool. Remember your umbrella, watch out for dampness, and take care!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门雾气浓，湿度高。出行注意视线，小心路滑，保持好心情！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is very foggy and humid. Watch your visibility, be careful on slippery roads, and stay cheerful!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛雾气重，体感寒凉。出行减速，注意防潮，多穿衣别冻着！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is very foggy and cold. Drive slowly, watch out for dampness, and layer up to stay warm!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连有霾，体感偏凉。出门戴口罩，保护呼吸道，注意保暖哦！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian has haze and feels cool. Wear a mask outdoors to protect your lungs, and stay warm!
